F1.description: Persuasion, persistence in developing a point, directness, organization and prepared delivery go together, and stand against scene-setting detail.
F1.higher: More direct, organized, persuasive talk that develops a point.
F1.label: Direct, organized argument
F1.lower: Looser talk with more scene setting and less argument.

F2.description: Positive tone, pride, hope and interest stand against disappointment and criticism.
F2.higher: More positive, proud or hopeful wording.
F2.label: Positive tone versus disappointment

F3.description: Personal disclosure, self-critical wording, accountability and sadness go together.
F3.higher: More talk about oneself, including self-criticism, taking responsibility and sadness.
F3.label: Self-disclosure and self-criticism
F3.lower: Less personal disclosure and less self-criticism.

F4.description: Compassion, respect, benefit of the doubt, warmth and sociable wording go together, often with reported speech.
F4.higher: More compassionate, respectful and warm wording about other people.
F4.label: Care and regard for others
F4.lower: Less wording of care or regard for others.

F5.description: Narrative of events, scene setting and stated outcomes stand against rebuttal, deflection and questions put to viewers.
F5.higher: More storytelling: events in sequence, with setting and outcome.
F5.label: Narrative versus rebuttal
F5.lower: More answering back: rebuttal, deflection and questions to viewers.

F6.description: Energetic wording, anger, conflict, criticism and disgust stand against calm wording.
F6.higher: More energetic, angry or confrontational wording.
F6.label: Energetic and angry versus calm

F7.description: Humor, imaginative framing, amusement and irony go together.
F7.higher: More joking, playful, imaginative or ironic wording.
F7.label: Humor and imaginative language

F8.description: Hedging, stated limits of knowledge, open-mindedness and curiosity stand against certain, categorical wording.
F8.higher: More qualified, tentative and exploratory wording.
F8.label: Hedging and open-mindedness versus certainty
